annotations.title: Look up rental yields by area

description: Looks up average rent, average price and gross rental yield for local authority areas in England and Wales, from ONS rents and HM Land Registry prices updated monthly. Pass an area name to get its figures and national rank, or leave it out to get the highest-yielding areas, optionally within a region.

area.description: Local authority or town name, for example 'Manchester' or 'Newcastle upon Tyne'.

limit.description: How many areas to return when ranking.

region.description: Optional English region or 'Wales' to filter the ranking, for example 'North West'.

name: lookup_area_rental_yields
title: Look up rental yields by area
